notes.title: Roasting Beta now available for Mac
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the Roasting Beta is now finally out for Mac! We have also updated the list of know issues and we'll be working on fixing some of those bugs, top crashes, and adding more content for the next build. Same as Windows, here is a warning about your game save that is important to consider when participating in the beta.

[h1]Warning about Game Saves[/h1]

Your game save will work with the Beta of the Roasting update, and your progress will not be lost once the full update is out. However, [b]a save that has been upgraded to the roasting update v0.8.0 can't be used in the old version of Coffee Shop Tycoon, trying to do so will reset the save without warning.[/b] We know that this is not ideal, and unfortunately, the old version works like this, but we will improve this going forward and warn players about unsupported game saves.

For now, if you play the Beta, please stay on the beta branch until the update is fully released, otherwise, you can potentially lose your progress. If you want to keep a copy of your game save, you can follow these steps. That way, if you want to go back to the non-beta build, you can use that backup to restore your old save. That save will not include any of your progress while playing the Beta.

~/Library/Application Support/Riff Studios/Coffee Shop Tycoon/[/b]

Instructions about how to play the Beta and whats int the update can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/370060/view/3108040246274791484]HERE[/url]

If you want to know more about the development of Coffee Shop Tycoon and how the new mechanics work, check out this video!

[previewyoutube=xllFd9tT8MI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Roasting update Beta is now live for Windows!
notes.content:
The time has finally come, and the Beta for the roasting update is out now for Windows! The Mac version will be released next week as we still need to do more playtesting. Before I talk about any of the juicy details of the update and what you can expect from us over the following weeks, I want to go over an important topic, game saves.

[h1]Warning about Game Saves[/h1]

Your game save will work with the Beta of the Roasting update, and your progress will not be lost once the full update is out. However, [b]a save that has been upgraded to the roasting update v0.8.0 can't be used in the old version of Coffee Shop Tycoon[/b], trying to do so will reset the save without warning. We know that this is not ideal, and unfortunately, the old version works like this, but we will improve this going forward and warn players about unsupported game saves.

For now, if you play the Beta, please stay on the beta branch until the update is fully released, otherwise, you can potentially lose your progress. If you want to keep a copy of your game save, you can follow these steps. That way, if you want to go back to the non-beta build, you can use that backup to restore your old save. That save will not include any of your progress while playing the Beta.

[b]On Windows, go to this path, and copy all the folder contents to a safe location.
C:/Users/<your username>/AppData/LocalLow/Riff Studios/Coffee Shop Tycoon/ 
 
On Mac, go to this path, and copy the folder contents to a safe location.
 ~/Library/Application Support/Riff Studios/Coffee Shop Tycoon/[/b]

[h1]How to play the beta[/h1]

With that out of the way, let's go over some simple steps to enable the Beta.
Go into your library, select Coffee Shop Tycoon, click on the settings icon, and select Properties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/ddacb4ebbb73381ed4c9c581b4dfb8ffa3d43b06.png[/img]

From there, go to the beta tab and select Beta from the dropdown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/62760831da00a6f7857e466cf3f74d73770679dc.png[/img]

[h1]What can you do in the Beta?[/h1]

The Beta is pretty much the Roasting Update minus a few things we are still working on and some extra bugs 😊. Once you install the latest version, your first question is probably going to be, how do I start roasting? Like many other features in the game, Roasting is unlocked by completing missions, precisely, the mission to own another company on Akihabara. If you have completed that mission before or if you complete it after getting the update, you will see a message notifying you about the new Roasting area in the HQ, here you will be able to start your roasting adventure.

[h1]Akihabara and mission updates[/h1]

Akihabara has some graphical improvements for the cherry blossoms in the park and three additional objectives. If you have already completed this store or if you have already unlocked it before, you won't see these new objectives, but that won't prevent you from unlocking Roasting.

The three new objectives are:
•	Create a roasting profile
•	Buy a Roaster
•	Roast coffee in your store

As mentioned before, this store is where you will be able to unlock Roasting.

[h1]Roasting[/h1]

Once Roasting is unlocked, you will see this new space in your HQ. From here, you can see all the available beans from all over the world that you can roast, along with the bean varieties, roasting challenges, and information about the different continents. There are no tutorials in the Beta about Roasting, but we are working on adding them to the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/6177d1025adc6aeb20fd4a5460c75a9a648a8fb5.png[/img]

You will probably want to start by creating your first roasting profile. This is a sort of recipe that your employees can use in the store to roast the coffee that you want to sell. Select the employee with a high roasting skill and start roasting. Only employees with this skill or higher will be able to roast the coffee in your store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/eb71d7839316e7e08b467dd0017fb68db675f68d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/575f29a9f7a282ad593b7662e0543affac0f32a5.png[/img]

On the next screen, you will be able to play with the roaster and try to achieve different flavor notes for your coffee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/e726b7fa7bae9b85a04ce58a3c5e5e61a2efe92e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/8fbb20a29b45b5ae6a1de020cb32545e7bda6b34.png[/img]

Once you are happy with your roast, you can go over to the coffee bag creator, where you can set your imagination free and create an exciting design for your coffee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/7f398c5ba0908533fc10f9cbcc4502b7fe2ef5ad.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/9c3a5af69ebad8ca7561e8ca4b46fc9b8402e326.png[/img]

Finishing this process will create a roasting profile that can be used from your store to delight your customers with your unique coffee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/6902dd48c90a4451a57c5d70abd87126cf7acc98.png[/img]

Green coffee can expire and run out of stock, so be aware of this before creating a roasting profile for a coffee that will expire soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/e8c3886944035667b89e5ac844212d4559a0dfbd.png[/img]

Depending on your new roasting profile, you will potentially complete roasting challenges that have different rewards. Milestone challenges unlock unique rewards like new machines and world regions, while other challenges can give you money or roasting points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/a8ee876a58dad1c4fb62f8ba12df41b06212473a.png[/img]

Currently, there is only one milestone challenge in the Beta, but we will be adding more challenges to unlock the complete set of machines in the following weeks.

Roasting points are a new currency that you can use to buy new bean varieties and roast high-quality coffee. Unlocking varieties and continents will give you more options to choose from when roasting coffee. Asia is the first continent that is unlocked by default. New continents will be unlocked with milestone challenges that we'll be adding during the Beta.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/be2dfd2670492ccaa866257678a55c38133ebeb3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/f743f3a7160670170ec4483f59deb2ee338cf325.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/db86260ec8ac482d685e4a370e7ba8d532711259.png[/img]

Now that you have a unique coffee, go back to any of your stores and buy a roaster. You can reassign any of your employees to the roaster or hire a new employee with better roasting skill.
Click on the roaster, here you can roast your new coffee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/5f941e770cf4e2fd3b8e134fcc2c9d4a53b4cbad.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/4ce3af4c38f51a10d27bfa74793c2319e31e7609.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/2f006fa122780ce73e9721f977efbeb22f330f4c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/bf3cbcfea54d06b8647c0ccedcce98240eef7a21.png[/img]

After roasting, your coffee will appear on your Supply screen like any other coffee, and you can use it from your Brewer or Espresso as always.

[h1]Coffee grading and customers’ expectations[/h1]

Coffee quality is no longer defined by stars and is now using the real-world grading scale for quality. Depending on your store reputation, customers will have different expectations about your coffee quality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/03bcd2ef9140e55a52a3332ba855899d22242cf2.png[/img]

Machines also have a new property, "Max brewing quality," that is replacing the old "Quality" property. If you are roasting amazing coffee, also remember to have amazing machines. Otherwise, your customers will not be able to enjoy your coffee fully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/e736061850b5141208bbbf8682b046cba25dd20e.png[/img]

[h1]New requirements to increase your store reputation[/h1]

Roasting is now crucial to increase your store reputation. After reaching Bronze-Bean, you will need to sell coffee with good grading to level up. We are also adding a new reputation level called Diamond-Bean.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/1fad5318fae71d34d6df920ecfd0bd29d18f666a.png[/img]

For the Beta, you will need to unlock the Siphon Brewer to brew coffee with 85 points and increase your reputation to Silver-Bean. For Golden-Bean and Diamond-Bean, we are still working on adding the milestone challenges that will unlock the machines necessary to reach these ratings.

[h1]New location[/h1]

The new location with all its missions is now available after completing Akihabara. The mission objectives for this location focus on roasting coffee, completing roasting challenges, and unlocking bean varieties. Everything but the last objective can be completed at this point. The final objective is to unlock the four continents. This is going to be possible when we add the remaining milestone challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/7474f68e652323677958a1ff87dd65ab44a86769.png[/img]

[h1]New items[/h1]

Last but not least, you can expect to see many new items to decorate your store, including plants, three new concrete floors, new tables, chairs, a new working station with four airpot slots, new sugar tables to match each working station, and many more things. All of which are available in the Beta. Check out some of the new items you can buy for your store. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/85e58a7a3a387ec58d7b329005da482b0660c45a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/c9aa88deca67da916cd384b6ca9b89ccc372790e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/574a0ef4bed18891e61737cc42bed19aa32be1a9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/e9184a7d051f1441457773279b99363270c9ed96.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/9e9760d7a148cca078cecfde11c3cd6762fedd7a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/ee9bb673274d885af6e4e776d93d17c771731cbd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/22b2b38b3bf0616416568560fc63e02aec304a36.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/049f6b3cab87451d3e2794b1e8fc57c910e791a3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/7157706ef798348a73c0db2391fac68da19aa387.png[/img]

[h1]What is missing[/h1]

Now let's go over some of the things missing in the Beta that we will add over the following weeks.
[list]
[*] More Milestone roasting challenges to unlock all the new content.
[*] Tutorials for Roasting.
[*] Story introduction to 5th store.
[*] New help sections.
[*] New achievements.
[*] Balancing changes.
[*] UI sounds.
[*] Option to speed up roast results animations.
[*] Improvements to employee roaster selection screen (grouping employees by store).
[*] Notification when completing a roasting challenge.
[*] Bug fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Known issues[/h1]

[list]
[*] Some bean properties like long names and processes can overlap other UI elements.
[*] Animations on roasting challenge screen replay after a challenge is created or completed.
[*] Employee information screen does not refresh after training completes or employee levels up.
[/list]

[h1]Playing with us[/h1]

We will be streaming live on Sunday at 12pm PDT over Steam. You will be able to find the stream simply by going to the game store page or your library. We will be talking about the new features of the game and answering any questions. You can post questions on our Discord or over Twitter.

We hope that you enjoy playing the Beta, and please let us know any problem or feedback you have. As always, enjoy your coffee and happy roasting!

You can follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/RiffStudios]@RiffStudios[/url] for more updates.

notes.title: Dev Diaries October 22 - Beta Releases on October 29th
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Pumpkins are out, and ghosts are starting to haunt our office, but we have tried to ignore them, throw coffee at them and pretend that there is not a psycho killer behind us, everything we can to keep making steady progress! And we are back with another dev diaries. This is the last update before we release the [b]beta next Friday[/b]! Yeah! You heard it. We have finally completed the features necessary for the beta! We are currently playing the update and fixing any lingering bugs while tweaking the challenges and rewards. The balance of these new mechanics will probably not be perfect for the beta, but we hope to hear your feedback and, together, get the full update out by November.

With the beta release announcement next week, we will also talk about what work is remaining for the full update and what you will be able to do in the beta.

Now let’s talk about what we have been doing since our last update.

[h1]All new items and machines are now in the game.[/h1]

This month we finished configuring and adding all the new items and machines to the game. We are especially excited by the new decoration options and the new additions to espressos and brewers. We also finished configuring the three rosters, animating all the machines, and adding all the remaining descriptions. Check out some of the new items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/c9aa88deca67da916cd384b6ca9b89ccc372790e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/63bcea958ef840f69d94cac850f1a0cab8079c10.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/85e58a7a3a387ec58d7b329005da482b0660c45a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/e9184a7d051f1441457773279b99363270c9ed96.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/8bc3016f352c340d121d6e93dbb316516c922f7b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/574a0ef4bed18891e61737cc42bed19aa32be1a9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/6c71d47fcff65a8e4a25cb05ac10ae67e424f5b7.png[/img]

There are many more items, but you will have to discover them in-game; we are trying to keep some surprises for next week ;)

[h1]New unlock mechanic[/h1]

Historically on Coffee Shop Tycoon, you can unlock items by leveling up, buying companies, or doing researches, now we are adding another way to unlock new items.

With the addition of roasting challenges, we decided to have the new higher-level machines and roasters locked behind what we call a Milestone Challenge.  You will complete these challenges by creating new roasting profiles in your HQ. These milestones are also tied with the coffee varieties and coffee regions. Milestones will be increasingly more challenging and will help you become a professional roaster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/4f4691191adc252ce7efc23b2a4f6a4ef45b6a0e.png[/img]

[h1]Roasting Challenges[/h1]

Speaking of challenges, the system is now fully functional. We have been roasting and completing challenges all week long. We plan to keep doing this and tweaking the difficulty and rewards next week. We are also working on the first Milestone Challenge that will unlock a new machine when you start playing the beta. We will keep adding more milestone challenges through the beta period until they cover all the new machines and the four coffee regions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/1d88c01cb37a01e6d044a2fb2e59670b7819c803.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/bfb3e213f86fc39da845971891a7d7682fd46671.png[/img]

[h1]World Coffee[/h1]

We have talked about varieties before and even showcased the screen a couple of updates ago; with this latest push, we are also adding the world coffee screen. On this screen, you can get an overview of what coffee varieties are available in each continent and what coffee notes you can expect per continent. You will start with one continent unlocked, and as you progress through the world of roasting, you will get the chance to complete new Milestone missions to unlock the remaining regions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/be2dfd2670492ccaa866257678a55c38133ebeb3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/f743f3a7160670170ec4483f59deb2ee338cf325.png[/img]

[h1]Diamond bean and changes to reputation levels[/h1]

Another change coming to the game is the addition of a final reputation level, Diamond Bean. This is the next tier after Golden Bean, and to unlock it, you will need to sell coffee in your store with an exceptional grading. This new mechanic is also required to achieve Silver Bean and Gold Bean.

Each rating has a different coffee grading requirement, starting with 85 to achieve Silver Bean, 90 for Golden Bean, and 95 for Diamond Bean. For each level, you will need to sell at least 20 coffees with this grading. Hopefully, you keep an exceptional service since you will need to sell the coffee again in case you lose your reputation level, but don’t worry, this is just a requirement for the top reputation levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/d5d49a062e361af29d1710e9ba34a0fe755a95cd.png[/img]

[h1]Brewing quality and customers' expectations[/h1]

You might have amazing baristas in your team, but to brew great coffee, you also need great equipment. For that reason, we are introducing a new stat for your brewers and espressos, Max Brewing Quality. You can brew any coffee in any machine, but it will not realize its full potential unless you have the right equipment. You will get a notification if it is time to upgrade your machines. The machine stats will reduce the coffee grading until you get a better machine, so better to be ready with adequate equipment when roasting amazing beans.

This grading is important because your customers now expect a different coffee grading depending on your reputation. This expectation is slightly different between customers, but overall higher reputation means higher demands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/f5dae6d601ba1b081bbe523f7a24660630232de5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/a34a2e53d8e12248d4b821e6a4ed2dec82c9af37.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/4a9a434205ff88d5f23216ae051f9c4766b5dfdb.png[/img]

As you can see, roasting is crucial to having a successful store and becoming the ultimate coffee connoisseur!

We are excited to finally start sharing this update with you and hear about all your thoughts and suggestions.

[h1]Playing with us[/h1]

As a final surprise, we plan to stream a gameplay session and talk about some of the new mechanics and answer any questions you may have, we don’t have the exact date and time right now, but we will update you once we do.

Thank you for reading this far, and we hope to see you next week for all the instructions about how to download the beta and all the information about it, plus more details about the stream. As always, enjoy your coffee.

You can follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/RiffStudios]@RiffStudios[/url] for more updates.

notes.title: Dev Diaries September 7 - Roaster Animations, Roasting Challenges, new screens
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you have been enjoying summer, at least in the northern hemisphere, we have certainly had. Today's update is a little longer than usual, given the last update was in July. Since then, we have implemented the majority of the remaining features for the roasting update. The next milestone will focus on wrapping things up to publish a beta, more information about that further down.

[h1]Bag Creator[/h1]

Last time we talked about the progress on the coffee bag creator. We are happy to announce that the creator is now complete, including loading and saving custom designs. This is a feature we really wanted to have; we know making new designs is very cool, but we also wanted to have a way to reuse existing designs to speed up the progress of roasting a new bean, especially if you're going to have a recurring type of roasts like real-world coffee roasters do, or simply a common branding between your beans.

[previewyoutube=qYWzvIJMWV4;full][/previewyoutube]

A nice feature of the bag creator is that it allows you to add custom text to your bag and text representing specific properties of your coffee, like country of origin, flavor and aroma notes, name of the coffee, etc. Every time you load a design with these text elements, they update to match the information of the bean you just roasted. The store logo also works this way, if you decide to change your company's logo to a new one, the new roasted coffees will also have your new logo.

[previewyoutube=C3J5CAqBCCg;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/f384c845d8d25f3b4df2d1ac09d2865397ed8227.png[/img]

[h1]Roaster animations[/h1]

Another major area that we focused on was roaster animations and sounds. In this milestone, we completed the set of animations and sound effects for the three roasters we are adding to the game. You can see these animations while roasting new beans from the HQ or the store. We are very excited about the result, and we hope you enjoy the soothing sounds of cracking coffee or the calming flow of coffee beans over a cooling tray; as someone commented on the Twitter post, you can almost smell the video.

[previewyoutube=7Zw08CHnUyk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Updates to the roasting screen[/h1]

We also updated the new roasting screen with more controls. We want to give you all the tools to have fun while roasting; this includes playing with time and pausing to allow you to plan your next move and not get frustrated. You can also see the entire flow of roasting in the following video and the roaster animations once more in action.

[previewyoutube=Z05KI8HdGb4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Roasting Challenges[/h1]

Now, a quick refresh on coffee varieties and how they tie to roasting challenges. When you start roasting your first coffee, you will notice that you won't have access to the rarest higher quality coffee varieties from the start. To become a great roaster and have stellar coffees, you will need to unlock higher-quality coffees. These coffees are unlocked through roasting points that you can obtain by completing roasting challenges.

We are putting a lot of time into this system to ensure that challenges can be exciting and fun to do.
We have two different categories for roasting challenges:

[h3]Milestones:[/h3]
These are your main story, hand-crafted challenges. They tell a story about your progress as a roaster and unlock unique rewards. Those rewards include coffees from new continents, new roasters, and new machines like espressos and brewers.

[h3]Other (name TBD):[/h3]
These challenges are procedurally generated, and the rewards are usually roasting points or money. They can also have an expiration time if they have higher rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/04bc21ca96adffc180fee0ce407fd75a66e16997.png[/img]

All challenges have objectives that can be accomplished by roasting only one coffee or a series of coffees with specific properties. An example of a challenge can be: "Roast a coffee from Africa with 82 points or more." Another example could be "Roast 5 coffees from South America and roast 2 Dark Roast coffees".

We are still working on finishing this system to ensure that all challenges can be completed and are relevant to your current level. We are also adding the option to skip non-milestone challenges if they don't sound exciting or rewarding enough for you.

Challenges are generated in a time-based manner. We are thinking of having only three procedurally generated challenges at a time, so after you complete or skip one of these challenges, a timer will kick in, and a new challenge will be generated after "x" time to fill the spot.

[h1]New bean screens[/h1]

With new properties for coffee and roasting, it was necessary to update the existing beans in the game; previously, these beans only had one important property, quality, represented by a number of stars. Now beans are moving to the new model that is closer to real-life coffee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/0d64181743055f70fcda2c6049897e56e3d91000.png[/img]

Coffee is now graded by a score; customers will have a different expectation for this score depending on the reputation level of your store. Besides the score, we also added information about the flavor notes, origin, and other properties to the original coffee beans and updated the Supply and Brewing screens to reflect these changes. On a game that focuses around coffee, we feel that having more information about the coffee you are selling and roasting will add a new level of realism to the game. 

Hopefully, you will learn a bit about the fantastic world of coffee while playing; we've certainly learned a lot while working on the game and have come to appreciate coffee in a very different way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/ce0ffd3e09f1798913b0a7295fe3a939bbf00671.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/3f88ccce199d20b80880e0d7e061dd71886cc516.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/fe543e3e76d1cf8b617421cc9d32804d5de2e966.png[/img]

[h1]What we are working on and Beta[/h1]

So, what is next? As you can see, the update is coming together, but we still have a bit of work left to finish it. We are spending the rest of September finishing the roasting challenges system, adding all the new items to the game, implementing the new location missions, and tweaking and playing with the new systems to ensure an excellent experience for the beta. Our plan is to have a beta by mid-October. We always have open betas, so if you want to test out the next update you will be able to, we will have an exact release date for the beta on the next dev diaries.

As always, thank you for playing and supporting the game, we love working on the project, and we hope all the new features will also make you love the game. Thanks for reading this far, and enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: Dev Diaries July 9 - New mechanics, new Screens, Coffee Bag Creator
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you are enjoying a cold brew this summer in the northern hemisphere or a velvety latte this winter in the southern hemisphere. Wherever you are, we wanted to share with you more news around the development of the latest update and talk about the new mechanics.

[h1]Roasting in store[/h1]

The roasting mechanic is now also working inside the stores and has a new icon. Once you have purchased a new roaster, you can assign an employee to it. This will allow you to roast any roasting profile created from the HQ as long as the beans are still fresh and available. Like brewing, roasting takes some time; after the roast is complete, the new custom coffee will appear in your inventory, and you will be able to brew it like any other coffee. Custom coffee will have better grades than the ones you can purchase, and they will be less expensive to produce; additionally, higher reputation levels like Bronze Bean, Silver Bean, and Gold Bean will now be tied with custom coffee because let’s be honest if you are a trending and fantastic coffee shop you might as well create your own coffee. 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/1e3a7b28ff332a7711d598ab782601bfb8eb9270.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/bfafec5a2635db58900b1c46980ce9932f3b3971.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/79c73f38030f754d74d1d128d2c8b935e34be6bc.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Screens[/h1]

This month we also made tremendous progress with the new screens. The brand-new Green Beans screen showcases the properties of the coffee beans you can use to create new roasting profiles from the HQ. These beans will change depending on which varieties and regions you unlock; they will also refresh constantly unless you make a roasting profile for them. When you create a roasting profile, the selected beans will be around until you finish roasting all the stock, or they become too old to roast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/fa28283364962bacc6948ced50b756d988d1896d.png[/img]

Speaking of coffee varieties, we also added a screen where you can unlock new varieties with roasting points. Varieties are crucial to complete roasting challenges which reward you with Roasting Points that you can use to unlock more varieties or roast high-quality beans. The expected quality of each variety defines different tiers; not all varieties will create highly rated coffees. Still, they will work as stepping stones to progress your roasting skills.

[previewyoutube=7P_AMJAvpzE;full][/previewyoutube]

Another new screen is the roasting hub, here you can check out the roasting profiles you have created, check the roasting challenge you are currently tracking, see information about how many regions and varieties you have unlocked, and finally create a new roasting profile. This is the main screen you will see when interacting with the new roasting department in your HQ.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/fb2f2cb66a4e6c6dca7fcd50341dfcd260b8412f.png[/img]

[h1]Coffee Bag Creator[/h1]

Another primary system that we want to show you is the coffee bag creator! This creator is your final step for showcasing your coffee. For the past weeks, we started working with an artist (you can follow here on Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/nynydg?s=20]@nynydg[/url]) to create different shapes and patterns that you can use when designing a coffee bag; here are some of the designs and explorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/a8c11967ce86667e88989529c492df8810083338.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/e64cae824efb5843c1f727dab2b1828ce33f7a3a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/ce373a23cb798cd40a1e7c877d249e7e2d3247c1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/f83aeb573b4c4e303ba68ad4aa02cad2591a6dce.jpg[/img]

She came up with 80 different shapes and patterns that you will be able to use to customize your bag; all these elements can have custom colors and combine with text to show your brand and the name of your roasted coffee. All these shapes live in layers that combine like an image editing software so you can rearrange their order and overlap them to create unique designs. Without further ado, here is the bag creator in action.

[previewyoutube=MbZj5poPIB4;full][/previewyoutube]

We are still working on adding support for text and different fonts, recent colors for the color picker, and the ability to save and load your bag designs. We are very excited about how it is turning out, and we hope you are too when you start roasting and selling your own coffee.

[h1]Challenge system[/h1]

Last but not least, we are also working on a powerful system that will support the roasting challenges. This system is flexible enough to be used for the missions currently in the game and any future games that we develop. The idea behind the system is to be able to define a set of requirements to complete a challenge that can be done in steps or at the same time and provide a reward if all the conditions are met. The system also supports having a sequence of challenges, similar to what you can see now on the current missions in the game. We are still testing this system. Given it is not a visual-facing feature, we only have the following debugging screens, but we are excited about how this will allow us to create interesting roasting challenges for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/49112fa4f011d033630f376e187f362a3138114c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Wrapping up[/h1]

Thanks for reading this far and supporting the game. We can’t wait for you to play the new update, we are doing everything to get it in your hands as fast as possible. Thanks for being patient and sticking with us, we hope you have an amazing week and enjoy your coffee!

You can follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/RiffStudios]@RiffStudios[/url] for more updates.

notes.title: Dev Diaries May 21 - Roasting Mechanics, Roasting challenges, and Emerald City
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are back with another development update for the Roasting update, we have made good progress since the last update, focusing on polishing the roasting mechanics, creating the roasting challenge system, and finishing the 3D models for the location.

[h1]Roasting mechanics[/h1]
The roasting mechanics are ready! We still have to tweak some numbers and finish adding animation, sounds, and UI, but for the most part, the ability to roast beans and sell them in your store is already working. First, you start by selecting a bean, picking an employee from any of your stores, and finally starting the roasting process. Here you tweak the heat levels to achieve the desired tasting notes, discovered notes will be visible as long as the coffee bean is in the market, you are ready to finish your roast once all notes have been revealed and the bean is no longer underdeveloped.
In the result screen, you are able to see how well your roast went and get a final score for your roast profile. The skill of your employees along with the bean variety and coffee notes determine your final score. Only employees with the same roasting skill or higher will be able to roast these beans, so having one rock star is not enough to sell this coffee at all your locations.
[previewyoutube=BFxh9qW3FgM;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]*UI in development[/i]

Back at your store, clicking on a roaster with an assigned employee will allow you to roast those beans, once roasted, they will appear in your supplies as any other bean. Existing beans have been modified to include the same stats as roasted beans (score, notes, roast).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/d6a5c1bdbdb8284ff662fe780c48a31c253687d4.png[/img]
[i]*UI in development[/i]

Depending on your reputation, customers will expect higher scored beans, and just like décor rating, specific coffee gradings will now be required to achieve bronze, silver, and gold ratings in your store.
That’s not all, we are also introducing the concept of roasting challenges!

[h1]Roasting challenges[/h1]
To become the best roaster and sell the best coffee you will have to prove you are one with the coffee bean, so to inspire you to become a coffee master we are adding Roasting Challenges! 
When you start roasting, you won’t have access to all the coffee beans in the world, coffee beans are unlocked by regions and varieties.
Regions can be unlocked by completing specific roasting challenges, each region has a different set of possible coffee notes, some have Fruity coffee, some others Nutty or Sweet notes, and not only that! Coffee Beans can also be unlocked by varieties. Varieties have different quality levels and are unlocked with roasting points that are collected by completing roasting challenges. As you progress in your roasting adventure you will unlock higher quality varieties and more exclusive coffee to sell in your store.
Roasting challenges will also unlock unique machines including Espressos, Brewers, Roasters, and a new Grinder. We hope you have fun completing these challenges and learn how to roast the most incredible virtual cup of coffee.

[h1]Emerald City[/h1]
We have a name for the new location, and it is “Emerald City”! This is the nickname of the city of Seattle, where most of the development of Coffee Shop Tycoon has taken place, this is also a city where our dreams as game developers started becoming a reality, so we couldn’t find a more fitting name for the location.
As you can see from the pictures below, the new location is almost ready! This is the largest location in the game so far, and we have had a lot of fun planning and designing the space, we hope you also have a lot of fun playing in it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/4b48abb0535cb4a6ba5df119daf2000c3ef32273.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/2f2c895e37f7318ef1998c74caecf3b65a7642d5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/84a9bbdaac85373f311332ac4d1c570ab9b0eed2.png[/img]

Emerald City is a big space where you can feature your new Roaster and large working station, it also has an alley which can be bought as an extension to your shop. Once bought, the alley will be converted into a magic place where coffee and city merge into a single experience.
At this point, the only thing remaining is to add the location's missions, and some traffic to make the environment feel like a living place.
We have also started configuring the new items, all models and textures are ready but we are still configuring them to work with the game since we have prioritized finishing up the roasting mechanics instead.

[h1]Wrapping up[/h1]
We are very close to having all the main systems working, we are currently focusing on finishing the remaining UI, animations, sound, missions, bean bag customization, and other final details before we can give a definitive release window. Considering the size of the update we will publish it first as an open beta, we hope to give you a date for the beta next month and show you more finalized screens and videos of all the work we are doing. Thank you for all your patience and for supporting the game, we are truly doing everything we can to bring this to you as soon as possible but we are still a small team and the coffee intake is already pretty high :D

You can follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/RiffStudios]@RiffStudios[/url] for more updates. See you soon on the next update and thanks for reading this far, as always enjoy your coffee! And stay safe.

notes.title: Dev Diaries March 19 - Roasting, New location, and Discord updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone, welcome to the first post in our series of Dev Diaries, the idea around these diaries is to keep updating you often with all the development news and stories around Coffee Shop Tycoon. This is going to be in the same format as previous announcements, the only difference is that we want to publish them more consistently even if there is nothing super flashy to show to you, on those cases we’ll try to come up with fun stories around development or delve a little into some mechanics and the reasoning behind them. For this week, however, we have some flashy cool things to show to you!
Last month has been super interesting, we have made good progress on the Roasting update and we also spent some time doing virtual activities in the studio, improving our Discord, and updating the store description of Coffee Shop Tycoon.

[h1]Roasting update[/h1]

First, let’s talk about Roasting. If you didn’t know, the next big update will include the ability to roast your own beans, and a new location, plus new machines to brew and grind your coffee to perfection. Now that you know what roasting is let’s talk about this month's progress. This month we finished the “Green bean Generator”! This system is in charge of creating all the varieties of beans that you are going to use for roasting, we have a database of over 1000 coffee beans from around the world! So this system is in charge of reading these beans and adding unique notes depending on the region, in coffee lingo, “notes” refers to the series of flavors and smells you can perceive when drinking coffee, as a roaster you will have the responsibility of extracting these notes to create a rich and tasty cup of coffee. The available coffee beans that you can see in the HQ will depend on your progression, more about that in a bit.
For reference, here are some of the beans that can be generated with this new system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/b945f847a01f1b9f03459bdbbc76226f479a22d3.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/5ed65f2db83ad8fe2332312ab9bb6ce0af4e2c87.jpg[/img]

Another large chunk of this month was allocated to developing internal tools that could help us import and test content faster, specifically the items you can buy and place in your store. When I started developing Coffee Shop Tycoon, I was pretty much an amateur game dev fresh out of college so I didn’t know all the magical benefits of using editor scripts or how to make them. So, every item you see in the game has been configured manually to work with the game systems, this means that I had to import the 3D model, attach some scripts to it, make sure the pivots and colliders are fine, attach some other scripts, change tags and layers for the object, create points that will occupy slots in the game grid, and so on… This process takes around 15 to 20 minutes per object, simply to be able to put it in the world. When you are adding 15 or more new objects you can imagine how that can escalate pretty quickly even without considering human error when applying the configuration. Editor scripts to the rescue! Now after learning the benefits of editor scripts and spending time making them, we can now import and configure the same object in less than a minute, you can see how this will not only make our lives easier but helps us iterate over content a lot faster than we used to. And for the kicker, here is the editor script in action!

[previewyoutube=kM_dSPNm-SU;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, to art! This month we have been working mostly on polishing the new models and working on the new location. And speaking of the new location, drum roll please…tr tr tr tr tr

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/62971130cec65ca43d3a57ce95c21bf2aacf56d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/9bd377ebb75b2250944e2a73485ab8df52daaffe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/fcf4b07d39ec84f770d41a8ac14ac6189f724f58.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/c483b9d91c946a2297d05a53b2c84822613fb20c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/e9c34c5162086e95a69ae2a8d0fa89d6a0474bdf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/7defa75cc1b15df02d16a0a6e2dc0a8fcd0826d8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/957631b799b1b7a757a15761e375dde05f1afa26.jpg[/img]

Welcome to “Emerald City”, we are happy with how the new location is coming along, we still need to import it in the engine and start adding some nice lighting and game systems to be able to play inside the new building, but the modeling and texturing are ready and we are excited to bring this new place to life and fill it with the energizing aroma of fresh coffee, new machines, and new items. You can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/RiffStudios]Twitter[/url] where we will be posting screenshots while we add the new location to the game or wait for the next dev diaries to see more screenshots.
Now, do you remember we talked about unlocking beans depending on your progression? Well, these next weeks we are working on a feature called “Roasting challenges”. When the new update is out and you head over to your HQ you will see that beans from some regions of the world will be locked, but don’t worry you will be able to unlock beans from all around the world by completing roasting challenges, these challenges will test your roasting skills and yield amazing rewards, an example of a roasting challenge is as follows “Roast a bean from South America with at least 80 points from the Bourbon variety.“ We’ll be sharing more details from this feature along with some screenshots once we have it up and working.

[h1]Discord[/h1]

Having a fun place for our community to discuss the game and providing a direct channel to hear about feedback and ideas is important to us, for that reason we also spent some time improving our Discord and adding some new things to welcome new members. Now, when you join the Coffee Shop Tycoon discord you will be able to pick a favorite drink and be assigned to a team where you can get some exclusive in-game logos that you can import and use for your shop, we need some help to reach at least 7000 members in order to make the discord discoverable and public, we are still far from that but hopefully, with your help, we will one day. So, if you love Coffee Shop Tycoon, and want to get some cool new logos join our discord! 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/85eb30d3a968e3abc7e111854a8a2d3d77b2663f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Game Jam[/h1]

Finally, another fun virtual activity we had in the studio was a small game jam over the weekend, the idea behind these game jams is to help us learn and come up with fun ideas for this game or future games that we develop, this game jam topic was “Survival”, and we tried to make a survival around sound, here are just some of the screenshots and videos from that day.

That is all for now, hopefully, you like the new things we are adding to the update, as always let us know what you think here, at [url=https://twitter.com/RiffStudios]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/YMfNhaj]Discord[/url] (join join 😉), have a great weekend and enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: New update v0.7.2 and news about Roasting
notes.content:
Hello! I hope you are having a great week, here on Puget Sound we are preparing to be covered in snow soon, so stocking those coffee beans to get us through the week. As some of you might have noticed there was a small update pushed last week, this update fixes a game breaking bug that prevented you from closing the Employee information screen if the screen was open during the Du Latte Awards. We validated other screens and it seems that only this screen had the problem, it looks like there was a glitch with the unity controls that made the close button fly away from the screen when it disabled and re-enabled. Other than that fix there isn’t much else on the update, we have been focused on the Roasting update so we have everyone working on getting this update to you as soon as possible.
Speaking of roasting we have some cool new working screens to show you the progress and talk about the new mechanics.

[h1]So how will roasting work?[/h1]
First, we are introducing a new skill for your employees “Roaster”. This skill works similarly to the other existing skills, your employee will level up the skill through roasting or by taking some of the new trainings. You are also able to find employees that are specialized in roasting. Employees on existing saves will also have this skill, so you will be able to start roasting right away.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/3fdf11d7fbdb44ca05c7cd900f5bc809415d713a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/07358ef254861eac6c908e1285ebc215825e6da0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/88e8ad05ffc61ec9db69b2d00e36dbbebf106fa4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/dd4fadd898f931e9daf8da1eb734dc550e48122a.png[/img]

Roasting can be done in the HQ and your coffee shop, the first step is to go to your HQ, here you will find a new Roasting area where you can browse green beans from several origins and different properties, we are actually working right now on the system that generates all this beans. From there, you can pick a type of bean and start making a new “Roast Profile”. You will need to pick someone from your existing employees to do this, their roasting skill will be important to achieve a higher score for your roast. During roasting you will come across several flavor and aroma notes that are present in the bean, depending on the temperature you use for your roast you can try to get different notes. Once you have discovered these notes on that specific bean you can try to get other notes. 

[previewyoutube=Rgaj8BzPOCQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The selected bean, achieved notes, and the employee skill level will define the final score for your coffee beans. These scores will be important to your customer, a higher reputation store will require better coffee beans in order to progress. Bronze, silver, and gold bean ratings will be updated to take into consideration specialty coffee and custom beans.

[previewyoutube=fdxN-9EGW2s;full][/previewyoutube]

Back in the store, any employee with enough skill level will be able to roast the “Roast Profile” you just created from the HQ while there are enough supplies of the specific green bean. Green beans will change over time.

We are also working on system to customize bean bags so you can add your own style to your new roasted beans, we will share more details on another dev update.

Finally, we are going to leave you with some new renders from our talented artist, thanks for reading so far and enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: Now with Steam Cloud! v0.7.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/71cc71306c467cf7733105bdedffce9a4ca654d7.png[/img]

Hello everyone! I have exciting news today, Coffee Shop Tycoon now has Steam Cloud! Sync your game progress between any PC and Mac. Custom drinks and logos also sync so you can continue managing your Shop anywhere you go.

In order to support Cloud Saves, we needed to make some changes on how the previews of custom drinks and logos are saved, Windows users are not impacted by this but if you are a Mac player you will need to do one small step to recover your custom drink previews.

[h1]For Mac players (fix for missing drink previews)[/h1]
If you are playing on a Mac you will notice that your custom drinks' preview on an existing save is missing, to fix this you will need to move some files.
[olist]
[*]Go to this folder on finder "~/Library/Application Support/Riff Studios"
[*]Copy every drink preview you see into the "Coffee Shop Tycoon" folder and rename each file to remove "Coffee Shop Tycoon\\" from the name
[/olist]

Sorry for the problems in Mac but we hope you find Cloud Saves a good addition to the game, thank you for all your support and enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: Employee roles and Help section. New update v0.7.0 is live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you are enjoying the beginning of Fall and for those with cold weather, the additional reasons for having a hot cup of coffee. The last months have been busy and full of work; I took a coffee tasting and roasting course to help design the Roasting feature while working on improving the employee system to support it. At this point I have a very good idea of what roasting is going to look like and just need to work out some details while implementing it. The artist should start working shortly on the roasters, and I’m also happy to announce that a new developer is joining the team to help bring Coffee Shop Tycoon to 1.0 and out of early access.
For v0.7.0 the focus was on improving the employee system in the game, adding original music, and finally adding a Help manual in-game, there was also a lot of work around polishing existing screens and fixing existing bugs.

[h1]Employee roles[/h1]
Employees haven’t been very specialized in the past, while you could recruit someone with better barista skills, in the end the total impact was just a sum of the barista skill for every active employee. So, you could have an employee that was great all around and there was no reason to have one skill prioritized over another. With the addition of roles, now not all skills are relevant, starting on v0.7.0 now employees need to have assigned roles, you can choose a Cashier role or a Barista role, these roles can be exchanged any time but only the highlighted skill is active. You can also assign both roles to one employee when starting out but the performance of each skill will be decreased.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/782298c7461917fadff9853f2274d51394610a11.png[/img]

Skill progression was updated to consider roles, now, an employee skill won’t improve automatically if it is not in use by the current role, for example, a Barista will end up with a low Service skill over time unless that skill is specifically trained.

To support this feature, a new employee screen was added, from here you can assign, unassign, fire, specialize, train, update roles, adjust salaries, and check all current stats and active boosts. You can access this new screen by clicking on the employee or through the bottom employee menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/383e5f27654b0e75ed22d4a0da6b1c96a8c4bf66.png[/img]

The roles of employees are removed when they are unassigned, only active employees will have roles assigned to them.

[h1]Inspiration moments[/h1]
Another new feature for employees is “Inspiration moments”, previously, the only boost that employees could have was through the salary, now, depending on the role that your employee is currently performing a random inspiration moment can occur. Inspiration moments are more common for higher level employees and will have better perks. These are some examples of the type of boosts your employee can get:
[list]
[*] Coffee is brewed X% faster
[*] Instantly brews next X coffee batches
[*] Reviewer scores higher
[*] Customer X% more likely to order twice
[/list]
[previewyoutube=BKK1kFjDkHY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Original Music[/h1]
I am also happy to announce that Coffee Shop Tycoon now has original music! I had the opportunity to work with the talented Chris A. Yenney on four new songs for the game including a new title screen song. I hope you enjoy listening to them while building your coffee empire as much as I did. You can follow Chris on twitter [url=https://twitter.com/chrisayenney]@chrisayenney[/url] or visit him at https://chrisayenney.com/ to check out other projects.

[h1]Help Section[/h1]
This has been a top request and something I’ve been wanting to add for a long time. Tycoons can sometimes be overwhelming, there are usually many systems in place and it can become frustrating trying to understand everything from small tutorials that can’t be replayed, for that reason I am adding a dedicated help section in-game that you can check any time. New topics will also be unlocked while making progress in the game to keep the current help sections relevant to your progression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/b465a59585c1da80fc2b8c5eabb040e3e32fbcfa.png[/img]

[h1]UI Polish[/h1]
Through the development of Coffee Shop Tycoon, I’ve been evolving the UI design, however some screens hadn’t caught up, for that reason, I spent some time going through all the screens in the game and updating them to match the latest design, also did some tweaks to that design to have a more pleasant aesthetic. I hope you enjoy controlling your coffee shop from these improved screens. There is still some work around making all scrollbars look the same but in my opinion that is at least less distracting than a different color scheme and title placement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/04bd15ba21d617d7bb011b2bce57d37faaddbbf8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/02115696209b5495523e835213c06c9f3f662eb6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/c47408468b51126c3ea6389905668cc1d37d5307.png[/img]

[h1]Tweaks to Beans, Food, and Ingredients quality[/h1]
I tweaked the quality of coffee beans, food, and ingredient crates to have a higher impact on the customer happiness and reputation, as a side effect, all current supplies in your shop will show 1 star even if they were higher quality. New orders will show the correct star rating.

[h1]Bug Fixes and Misc[/h1]
Finally, this update also includes bug fixes, and some minor changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed collision on three chairs (Chea, Isu, Anrakuisu) that prevented customer from reaching the chair.
[*] Specializations are now disabled when unassigning or transferring the employee.
[*] Fixed horizontal scroll in employee bottom screen.
[*] Fixed cashier collision on “Fancy Station”
[*] Fixed employee slot on “Japanese Station”
[*] Fixed Japan décor ratings
[*] UI bugs
[*] Added confirmation dialog when exiting hiring screen after interviews.
[*] Now there is no limit when hiring employees.
[/list]
[h1]Next Update[/h1]
As some of you know, next update is all about Roasting and a new location. Art work should start this weekend, design is almost done and development has already started. I will be posting some development updates along the way to share some of the exciting features coming to the game. Thanks for reading this far and enjoy your coffee.

Follow me at [url=https://twitter.com/riffstudios]@riffstudios[/url] on twitter for more updates.

notes.title: Update v0.6.6 is out
notes.content:
Hello everyone! After the latest update some players started reporting two major problems, first problem was that coffee beans were getting instantly old and second problem was around crashes in general. 

I tracked the bean issue down to an error while parsing the text resource files that include the rate at which coffee beans get old. Basically, this value is represented with a text like this "0.11", converting this into a number worked correctly before, but with the engine update I now needed to specify a format as some countries represent decimals with commas which causes issues while loading these files. I went ahead and applied the same fix to any number that is parsed with similar methods in the game, which should resolve a number of other unreported bugs,

Another major report was around game crashes, I had a look at the top crashes and applied several fixes, some of the crashes didn't have enough information to accurately say for sure what was happening, but for those crashes I restructured the code in a way that should give me more information in case it still crashes.

I'm working towards the next update and I will keep doing these minor bug fixing updates for anyone that hits major problems while playing the game. Your reports and feedback are very valuable to me, so please post anything that is on your mind on the forums, message me directly to @RiffStudios over twitter or send an email to riffstudiosgames@gmail.com.

Again, thanks for playing and enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: v0.6.5 is live for everyone!
notes.content:
Hello!

Update v0.6.5 is now available for everyone, this update includes fixes for pathfinding (customers getting stuck), ground work for localization, and a new engine. You can read the full details here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/370060/view/2542794099152786832]Update v0.6.5 Full Details[/url]

As part of the update I also refreshed the start screen and updated the Riff Studios logo, I hope you like the new logo and the new screen as much as I do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/d0701db49a6bea8fe06f9d61b1640d88cc4170b5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/b86c7c2d2715cb2a006a7e9dc31fc5e63e03fa43.png[/img]

[h2]About saves and launching the game[/h2]

A side effect of updating the game engine is that some file paths had to be updated, if you played the beta you might have noticed your saved progress was not there, this was due to the paths having different names, this problem is fixed now and you should see your previous save on the beta and live. 

For those curious, your save is stored here:
[i]C:\\Users\\<your user name>\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Riff Studios\\Coffee Shop Tycoon[/i]

The beta was incorrectly storing the save here:
[i]C:\\Users\\<your user name>\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Riff Studios\\CoffeeShopTycoon[/i]

If you have problems launching the game after the update or if you don't see v0.6.5 simply restart steam.

If for some reason you want to stay with the save file used for the beta, copy the files in the folder named "CoffeeShopTycoon" to the folder called "Coffee Shop Tycoon"

[h2]Next Update[/h2]

I'm currently working on the design and timing for the next update, I don't have specific details that I can share with you but I can tell you this little detail about the update, are you ready?
... 
[h3][b]Roasting!!![/b][/h3]
...

Yes! I'm working on adding coffee roasting to the game, I'm already thinking on how some systems will need to be changed to accommodate for this, including the employee system and the rating system, which means that while I work on this update there might be a small update in between that improves these systems just to give you something new to play with while roasting is complete, I will be sharing more updates on my social media Twitter(@RiffStudios) and over here when I have enough pieces done to write an announcement. I'm also switching to a different source control which should allow me to post more game updates while I'm working on large features, before, I was using Unity Collab which doesn't support branching, now I'll be using git instead, I've worked on so many nightmare merges that I feel I have sharpen my skills enough to outweigh the cons of git.

Please post in the forums, message me directly on twitter, or email me at riffstudiosgames@gmail.com if you have any problems with the game. Thanks for playing and enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: Update v0.6.5 on BETA for Windows
notes.content:
Hello everyone, a new version is available for beta testing, this update is focused on fixing some annoying bugs and also has a lot of work that will take Coffee Shop Tycoon to new audiences in the future. I'll start by talking about the bugs that were recently fixed and the two major changes that I've been working on during the past two months. Finally, I will share some exciting news about the music of the game.

[h1]Pathfinding[/h1]
Wow, switching a legacy path-finding system on a released game is really annoying but I think I'm seeing the light at the end of the tunnel. A little history behind path-finding, the game used to have a grid like navigation system, when you placed a chair or a table an area of the grid would be blocked and customers walked around the obstacles, this worked great but it was a very limited system, it didn't really support things like putting tables against walls, or expanding stores. For that reason, I switched to the NavMesh system provided by Unity, this basically calculates a walkable area using the actual 3D models of the objects and a customizable humanoid shape. This new system really opened the doors for a lot of the features and improvements I have added lately, but it came at a cost, now that you can be more flexible moving things around and expanding shops, it is more likely for customer to get stuck. The problem is that the customers in your store are not super smart, so in some cases they don't know what to do when a table is blocked or they end up in weird spots.

For this update I spent a long time looking at these flaws and finding ways to fix them. I don't think the system is perfect yet but it certainly handles most cases gracefully so you should not be seeing those annoying bubbles over your customer's heads that often, here is a comparison of the changes.

[previewyoutube=DF-RgSbPhSM;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see in the video, customers looking for a new table would get stuck if selected table was blocked, and customers that were on their way to a table that was previously reachable would also remain stuck if something blocked the path. Now with the changes, customers have a way to detect if tables are reachable and leave or find another table if that is not the case. Customers now also navigate directly to chairs instead of the middle of tables which should fix other similar bugs. The colliders of all tables were also updated to account for these changes.

[h1]Supporting other languages[/h1]
Another feature that I consider very important for the future of the game, and something that needs to get done before the game keeps growing is localization. The game was not designed with this in mind and I have gradually learned new best practices and how to better support multiple languages. During these months I have worked on building a language system for the game and extracting all in-game text from code, I was able to finish this first phase and have extracted over 400 lines of text. The remaining text that needs to be localized lives in some text resources like the store's furniture and drinks catalog, and UI controls. After I'm done extracting those, I will have a text file that translators can use to provide new languages to the game. Since this update has changed quite a lot of places that handle text, please report any bugs you see related with text, especially if you see text that looks like this "boost.rivalTrend.title", these are strings used to identify localized text, so if you see those instead of the actual text, something is not working.

[h1]Updating the game engine[/h1]
Another big item that needed work was switching the Unity version used by the game. There are many problems that are caused by bugs in the engine code, especially crashes. Targeting an old engine version was also bringing a lot of problems when building for Mac, as the backwards compatibility between macOS and old Unity builds is pretty terrible. Now that Coffee Shop Tycoon uses a pretty recent Unity build, I will be able to use the latest tools for building the game, support more platforms, and hopefully have less problems with random crashes caused by the engine.

[h1]Game launch settings is going away[/h1]
As part of the engine update, the launch window where you can select the game graphics settings is going away. Instead, you can now change the resolution from the settings menu in the game.

[h1]Original music coming to the game[/h1]
As some of you may know already, there is new original music coming to the game! The current music used in the game is under a Creative Commons license and is not original music. Chris A. Yenney will be the composer behind the music of Coffee Shop Tycoon, he is currently working on the new songs and I am looking forward to sharing them with you when they are ready, follow Chris on twitter (@chrisayenney) where you can find more about his awesome work.

I'm going to be working on polishing this build and getting it ready to go out of beta, meanwhile if you find any issues while playing the beta please post your problem under the pinned thread, I will be taking special attention to those bugs and getting them resolved before the beta is over.

As always thanks for all your support, and enjoy your coffee.

Follow me on twitter (@RiffStudios) for more updates, and feel free to DM me if you are having issues or simply if you are having fun with the game.

notes.title: Spring update is out! v0.6.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you are ok in these complicated times. I have been working to bring you a small Spring update, having been quarantined at home for the past month has given me extra time to work on the game and hopefully you will enjoy the new changes.

[h1]New Spring ingredients[/h1]
I’ve heard your feedback about the lack of Spring ingredients for the drink creator, this update adds 4 new ingredients, allowing you to finally create Spring drinks! Two of the new ingredients, honey, and honey swirls are available right away, while edible flowers and wild berry syrup are unlocked with the Creative Barista research. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/6510ca4c4b25999a01cfa2e83b9fe8e51850bd4c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Notification system rehaul[/h1]
While this is not really visible as a player, every notification and message in the game is now using a new simplified system, I’ve been wanting to do this for a while as it was a mess every time I needed to add new dialogs and messages, this change will simplify adding new content and it was needed in order to support multiple languages and localization.

[h1]Rebuy hotkey[/h1]
This has not been requested yet, but I though it was really needed. You have probably come across a time where you bought a table and now you wanted to put chairs around it, to simplify buying the same item multiple times I added a button to the right of the screen a while ago. Now with this update, this button also has a hotkey, so pressing “B” will act as clicking the button allowing you to buy things way faster.

[previewyoutube=laasK5o66MA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Sped up drink evaluation[/h1]
The drink evaluation process in the HQ is way faster now, the three judges drink the coffee at the same time and give their score together.

[previewyoutube=O4bj74dCClk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Drink Boost relative to menu[/h1]
Now all drink boosts are relative to the season of the menu you are currently modifying, so if the current season is Spring but you are modifying your Winter menu, all boosts will be as if Winter was the current season. This is probably the way it should have worked in the first place but I guess better late than never.

[previewyoutube=35yGKy0M-W8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Impact of featured drinks has been reworded[/h1]
The impact percentage that appeared in the “Market” category of a featured drink was not really helpful, I changed this percentage to a description instead, “Market” basically tells you If the drink you are featuring resonates with the market of your shop, and affects how much hype is created. So, if your market is mostly teen customers, launching a drink targeted to teens will have a higher hype.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/1ad0ea4e6dac7fbfc6ab8564af9749061ef360dd.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
And finally, some bug fixes.
[list][*] Airpots could appear as in use with zero coffee, this was caused by replacing you working station while a brewing process was active.
[*] Fixed a problem where an out of season drink effect was not properly shown in the customer information.
[*] Fixed a case where navigation arrows were visible in the store category page.
[*] Fixed a problem where the shop’s 3D name could block the customers’ paths in Akihabara.
[*] Adding missing syrups to the syrup bottles visible over the working stations.
[/list]

[h1]Next updates[/h1]
The roadmap stays the same, I will also probably add "Upgrading the game to the latest Unity version", as that should prevent the issues with mac and will also update to the latest pathfinding system which should fix some of the issues that are being reported.
[list][*] More locations and mechanics
[*] Cloud Saves
[*] Steam Workshop support
[*] More Achievements
[*] Support for more languages
[*] Help Section
[*] Optimizations
[/list]

As always thank you for all your support, and enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: New location, items, achievements, and missions available now!
notes.content:
Hello, update v0.6 is live now! This has been one of the most challenging updates to develop so far, but hopefully you will enjoy all the new things that were added to the game. This update expands the game in many ways, it adds a new location with new challenges, improves existing systems, and adds rival companies with cool rewards. 

[h1]Akihabara[/h1]
Akihabara is the 4th location of Coffee Shop Tycoon, inspired by the real location in Tokyo and other cities like Osaka and Kyoto. This new location is one of a kind as it allows you to build your coffee shop on top of a building, the available expansion unlocks a nice rooftop area where your customers can enjoy the views of the city and a cherry blossom park below. Prove your management skills on this new location, and help Akari turn this shop into a trending spot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/8c4f8d436c3eb6887a952ed518e0a383e5d9d975.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/9bcdcb4cb0abf51b99e339cbffb3631017d9987a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/087fdd1aed0bebc411d84e6089a83b64c19c5e52.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/2bc4b4df225cfa4274e791f688596b389ba2d47e.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Items[/h3]
You will also find many new items inspired by Japanese culture ready to turn your store into a unique and interesting place. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/be6e2de651b42dbad6e777a94c5e4971f6bea26c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/61e796ddf6570be718a98350743d61fa1f8d0a75.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/ee49197a8b9d18816858bf4cf4f8887fe13488d8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/4d6afa903beeb589f589e93c7be798fec3006b48.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/a93feffe97ab4a92475117168eea675c6f88d779.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/6bc8859d4e0e468e337935fe320988d2746fe652.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/f2418740b4e6427c6c6a7f1f8e3138dd4a40d824.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/f0bdfd7fbdfec612a917efff8713f4f5b0a52b71.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/99f73042dfeae1c7fc823436c45ebcf09d8b0d8b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/4ed54ed8a2ed9b69baf77b2fe3dc940e37450c00.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/9f9177821a91fa8f6f6eb11fb32bd6803b370543.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/1b8d5fb4a085c268ed6b5557a9e8157e3cc43e67.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/1dd1bf0aedf8a868fa8fdad58a1875ee4f0e37f8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/176c64d17b166ebba766aec33b454aa8e9c94612.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/6826def25aca1f140d8333d154d20885ae5c267b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/f0def0ebd042b7956a1be3471a88644284972711.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/a88cf6ce4e458094281f756aea1fbb276b5cddd0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/c7451f73c4fc4731c1bf2de3dee5d7536f60d2d5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/520a16c65dcf9d4639405d4b599ea6400dc1d08e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/48195b7b200cbaabe08670792a2db3af6ef60ccb.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/f35029d30b846576f63312c02e6f4d9e98c9e08d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/3c1827422e27f03851fdf7ebf258f78b394fdc82.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/aa60357df3aace8a5b9d6a107131f5bf57789c0d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/2d7bbc0671cf2b8d67159169e029bac0538e84e2.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/08801659f38eab96c0416ae289200fffa9bfb99c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/299a88b7431e11cf5c469f8ab0ffa50ad57c6409.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/9b59f240be71019859143483cfa13adb3a134b4f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/3eacc833b7051d69ef77be45431616162ee0179a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/ed78792ae48a8426699e5de4c10476a542a49127.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/c455aac9d8c6232ca9931b5ccb96cbdfd6a2b51b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/e3a7a39bcff6be9c909a9827f0b0008c3b10e19a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/bdd78bd23c95e8b3440c8513cd24e71a24e9a5ab.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/402f1edd78957f62d7688225b18a9a23bdd871f4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/821fda155ec0a694ecd31c7b1cf15a772667d022.png[/img][/url]

[h3]New Ingredient[/h3]
If that is not enough you can also brew new drinks using matcha, to delight any customer on your new shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/b3a32104aac840a1e3c8a55e2c602ed18eeb54c6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rival Companies[/h1]
Another major feature is "Rival Companies". These AI controlled companies will grow along you and try to become the best coffee shop around, thankfully these are public companies so anyone can buy their stocks, that includes you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/1689bbe63ab58aaf43e09b96c53b2ce21c09a942.png[/img]

Try to make wise investments and buy stocks from promising companies. The stock price from these companies will change over time depending on the companies' value, this gives you a chance to gain profits by buying and selling stocks or simply by waiting for the company to pay dividends. Beware, companies might go bankrupt any time, so look after your investments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/66bf0facb5f9ddf482071760111eeb9b794dbfde.png[/img]

Some companies have unique logos and rewards that you can unlock by buying out the company.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/cb6ca646b681758b9977eb3f8ff28df18a32dc61.png[/img]

If you choose so, you can sell a company that you own and recover the value of stocks and any money in that company's bank. But you won't be able to receive any more dividends from that company.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/4868549620808b15d00c65385599086494245e89.png[/img]

[h1]New trending system[/h1]
With the addition of rival companies, the trending system has been updated. When an ingredient is trending, launching a featured drink with that ingredient will start a popularity boost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/297cdb1c959d78068bda5941241ad1be9c9509e0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/90dcfb04d868ab1e909477d115c2f994c6266414.png[/img]

Failing to react to a trend can allow other companies to take advantage and launch a trending drink of their own, this will impact your store's reputation and give you a negative popularity boost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/6faf6b3cd705902c5b63ebab142bde2643abb81f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/9c491dff9c2cb9e42e6e19e86a3c77b04f31dcf9.png[/img]

[h1]New Achievements[/h1]
Nine new achievements are available for you to unlock! Prove you are a true tycoon by getting all of them!

notes.title: Final beta update before v0.6 release
notes.content:
Hello everyone! If you have been following the development of v0.6 you may know that the list of remaining work has been getting significantly shorter every week, today I'm very happy to announce that the work for the update is complete! The final part of the update is live and you can play it by selecting the beta branch.

This last update fixes important pathfinding bugs, and adds the final pieces of content, specifically two more rival companies with their own unlockables, (Sasquatch, and Ingot Roasting Co.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/f1f08430af50b31411631e6a973a941905bc04e5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/e4d390b1a98f9f8590fbc7e15cbd3c33e17f4ada.png[/img]

The two unlockables for these companies are very interesting, one allows you to add gold to your drinks giving them that extra fancy look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/0a23c33d29b594b65958ae8d059aa053b31c6eb6.jpg[/img]

And the other shop unlocks a new service "Compostables" which increase the reputation produced by your customers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/3b9803fdfe6f32e4d3b7cd2b5f631e45caa350c8.jpg[/img]

This update also adds the option to sell companies you fully own. By selling the companies, you will recover the value from the stocks and the money in the bank. I also added a new filter to the companies' screen where you can see all companies, companies you have sold, or any company that you owned stocks and went bankrupt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/4868549620808b15d00c65385599086494245e89.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/882772484bdd26bd33c4c94456d3b6654c4013fd.png[/img]
