notes.title: New update for the BETA (includes tutorials and mission's dialog)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm back with another update to the beta build, this time the update includes dialog for the Akihabara mission and tutorials for the new systems, specifically the Stock Market and the new Trending system. I also improved the way in which these new features are unlocked. 

The Stock Market is unlocked right after you unlock the second shop, this is early in the game but it allows you to start investigating how the companies' worth change over time and you can check out the cool rewards of some companies. Trending doesn't kick in until you learn how to create a drink and feature it. After this point you will start seeing trending ingredients and rival companies trying to take advantage of the trend, you will also see two new guiding messages from Mr. Danger to better understand how trends work. NOTE: there is still a bug where ingredients that you haven't unlocked can go trending, this will be fixed soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/dcbfbbb921b8b9eeb7e84fbd5bded20720bb1e14.png[/img]

Another small change, is the addition of a useful tooltip in your shop, that shows the active market balance campaign, this is especially useful when playing the Akihabara missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/ac549e1d71b601b6b0b86a7689b313d0da1711fd.png[/img]

Finally, I fixed two important bugs, a crash when trying to customize the floor of Akihabara and a bug where ingredients that are not actually in the game yet like 'Candy Dust' and 'Strawberry' show up as trending ingredients.

The to-do list is shorter every day and now these are the remaining items to fully release the update.
[list]
[*] Add two more rival stores with rewards(ingredients/cool item)
[*] Add option to sell company, recover value of all stocks plus money in bank
[*] Register stock purchase in expenses
[*] Add level restriction to AI trending
[*] Have stores trend affected by ownership
[*] Make detail descriptions expand for all items but stations
[*] Hide buildings in new location based on camera
[*] Add matcha
[/list]
A Japan shop without matcha? I don't think so, so I decided to add the new ingredient to the 
to-do list.

These items don't take that long, only the rewards for the other two rival shops, but every other thing is mostly code changes that should be done pretty quickly. Thanks to everyone that has reported bugs and given feedback, I hope you are having a good time. I will see you soon with another update, enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: Try the latest update! v0.6 BETA is live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It’s been some time since I posted the last update, but I wanted to have something cool for you before that, and that day has come. V0.6 beta is live now! This marks a big step for Coffee Shop Tycoon and it’s been one of the most challenging updates so far, it adds a lot of new content and simulated AI companies which meant learning a lot of AI principles on the fly, but I am happy with the end result and I hope you are too. 

[h1]Why Beta[/h1]
So… why beta? Well it is simple, first I want to have more people playing this update to stabilize it and fix any possible bugs that I haven’t caught yet, and second, the update is currently 90% complete which means I still need to finish some work before I can fully release it to the world, but don’t worry, the beta is open for anyone, so if you want to try it out there is nothing stopping you. Instructions on how to opt into the beta at the end of this post.

[h1]What is new[/h1]
I’ll start by talking about the rival AI companies, starting on this update, you will see a new button in game, this takes you to a screen with a list of other companies in the business of selling hot cups of heaven or “coffee”, as most people call it. These companies have their own dreams and goals and will try to survive as much as possible in the market, simulated companies will grow by selling coffee and trying to snatch those trends in the market before you do, they will also go bankrupt if they make bad decisions. If you play close attention you will see their net worth increase as time goes by and they level up or buy more locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/42c96565dc95f7732b1b235cce75dc5b76470fac.png[/img] 

As a successful Coffee Shop tycoon, you can buy stock from those companies, this will give you extra cash in your pocket when those companies decide to pay dividends. Among all the companies there are currently two strong rivals, Triton, and La boulangerie du parc, these two coffee shops are the top when it comes to pleasing their customers and they can end up being very valuable companies, if you decide to get rid of those rivals and be the only barista in town you can buy the full company, this will give you access to their logo and a cool reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/36b3ce5e21ebe458dc3642146d100fe473ea7bc6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/c1447231d2100d6c2e463a6aae7b8600caeaf9b7.png[/img] [i]Macarons from buying all stock from La boulangerie du parc[/i]

The rival companies will change with time as some go bankrupt and new companies emerge, so pay attention to the stocks you own as some of the companies might go bankrupt and you can lose your money if you don’t sell in time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/fd287dba97cfc484f24ba467a1d4db33e8cc56bc.png[/img]
 
The second big addition is a new location! FINALLY! I know right? Well following the same train of thought, this has also been the most elaborate location of the game. The new location is called Akihabara and it is inspired by the real location in Japan, you will find your brand-new store between the lights of shiny buildings and restaurants. Along the new location I'm also adding many new items inspired by Japanese culture and increasing the level cap of the game. You will find new decorations, tables, and even a new working station. This location also includes new missions. [b]One thing to consider is that on the beta version won't be able to go past the objective "Buy a new expansion" as I'm still working in that.[/b]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/55bd0bf0471d8b62534094aed91b8caabb9ace6d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/107710b025c2bde9376999d099f2cb0c960c7c9b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/aeba38546ac026fd0421e749df607a02308884da.png[/img]

[h1]What is missing[/h1]
So, what is missing to fully release v0.6? To answer this question, I'll post a list of tasks I'm currently working on and that I believe are needed for calling this update complete.
[list]
[*] Akihabara Store expansion
[*] Tutorials/Story conversation
[*] New items' descriptions
[*] Tweaks on AI behavior
[*] Adding market balance campaign to store UI
[*] Achievements
[*] Some animations
[*] Two more main rival companies with rewards
[*] Add option to sell company (to recover value of all stocks plus money in their bank)
[*] Tweaks to lighting in Akihabara
[/list]
 
The list might seem intimidating but many of those changes are very straightforward and don't require me to read a book on AI. Taking into account the holiday season and the list of work, I believe the full v0.6 update will be ready and released close to the third week of January. I will be updating the beta branch as I go so you will start seeing some of these things come to life before that date. 
 
Thanks for the support and love for the game, I always appreciate any feedback bad and good, and I will keep trying to make this game awesome so everyone can have a good time. I will share an updated roadmap once this update is done so you can know what to expect from the coming months. If you find bugs in the beta, please post them in the pinned channel, as I will be fixing those while working on the update. 
 
[h1]How to play the beta[/h1]
 
Go into your library, select Coffee Shop Tycoon, click on the settings icon and select Properties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/ddacb4ebbb73381ed4c9c581b4dfb8ffa3d43b06.png[/img]
 
From there simply go to the beta tab and select beta from the dropdown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25924491/62760831da00a6f7857e466cf3f74d73770679dc.png[/img]
 
Thank you for playing and enjoy your coffee!

notes.title: Update v0.5.3 is live! [Pathfinding major fixes and mac pink screen]
notes.content:
Hello everyone, as some of you know there is a big update coming that is still in the works, however I've been looking at bug reports and player feedback and I wanted to release an update to address most of the problems, specifically pathfinding. The last update completely changed the pathfinding system I was using in the game to be more dynamic and allow a deeper customization of your shop's layout, it also included a new AI system for your customers to identify when they were stuck. Unfortunately, as it happens with major system changes, there were some cases that the new system didn't handle gracefully, especially when your shop has many items around. This update fixes many pathfinding bugs and introduces systems to prevent having your shop completely broken because somehow someone managed to get stuck. Hopefully this will fix most if not all the pathfinding problems you have been encountering. This update also includes a fix for mac players hitting a pink screen.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE out of beta! Includes Store Expansions, new Items, new item placing system, and improved AI.
notes.content:
Hello,

After a long testing period and bug fixing, the new update is finally ready, I will do a recap of the features for this update and talk a little more about what is coming in the next update.

[h1]Store Expansions[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/5a13675407ad5d1b700a706f794f1151163da732.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/98df5326edf40f1b1e610d636c7575c055961204.jpg[/img]

Now you are able to unlock new areas on your shops! You can expand your shop by reaching the required reputation level and paying an expansion fee. The Second and Third shop have this option available, so you can start placing tables and decorations on the sidewalk or over a nice deck next to the lake. New stores will also feature expansions and will be created with this feature in mind to offer interesting options and multiple expansions.

[h1]New Items[/h1]

lic/images/clans/25924491/c9fe60e103b1c362728455192c3dea700ce4d26e.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/0dcb0fc327bec977cc052af0982ce9c86793fc38.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/927436ea12074f8b1c44823673c5ad7926f59f0c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/f36b5d0358bcd5a140f0cd1ab468ce79c6fabdaf.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/8f0331a16a97885ca23b78a9dd3b0c544166459e.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/5f0ce0fa30ee6f9a8e79c57a5cd4104e2d68fd3b.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/fbcc480d9192bdef51054ec36a6ca2659f037923.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/888c5de4a9db96969dd7692489f60a64a3da07ea.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/6cb68c1c485dbcc1c3822026a8ed5a1faa4396f4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/e5b714eab077c1c0e2e727269e0ffb8308f4e62d.png[/img][/url]

[h1]New customer behaviors[/h1]

Large tables can now be shared between customers that don't belong to the same group. These tables are commonly used for working and it adds a nice option to your shop as you will start seeing more customers drinking coffee at your shop. Drinking time for customers has also been increased so they will stay longer.

The new placement system allows you to get customers stuck, but they are now smart enough to stop and let you know that the path is blocked so you can let them move around.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/f365553d9160985b2d52596b61b1d8f0648bf5b0.png[/img]

[h1]Better placement and more options[/h1]

There are some common coffee shop layouts that were not possible due to the old grid system, for example, placing tables against the wall.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/2e51b9618fa6f1d02cd8fcd72809ce3a44be6614.jpg[/img]

The new grid system gives you the flexibility to achieve this and more. Placing tables was also a little restrictive as you had a big area around your table that needed to stay clear of any other object, now tables only use the occupied slots and you can even place tables together without any restriction. Individual tables that are next to another will not become a merged larger table, but customers will still use them as each portion was an individual table.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/4a65043a682f8d4fc7ecb048ef6984800fb248cd.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/0cb9e23d6d3b9557a0de3c735b686543e33ea301.jpg[/img]

Every small table now supports 4 chair slots, one on each side. Larger shared tables can support up to 8 customers at the same time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/4432430760be3897e5eeab0c1fa85a8c6cd0c84c.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/dce1553b876d772525239c9044191df0519a4ebc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Coming next[/h1]

Next update will be delivered way faster as I'm just planning on updating the Store UI. The number of items has increased quite a lot since I made that screen, and sometimes it is hard to find what you are looking for. The update will add groups and persistent state so you can browse between different categories like "Chairs", "Tables", "Decorations", "Seasonal" and go back to the same search after placing the item.

I will also keep working on the AI for rival stores and I will start planning the new content update which will include a new store location and new items.

Thanks for all the support and your great feedback that has helped evolve the game into its current state. I know there are many more exciting things to come for Coffee Shop Tycoon and I will keep working to bring you these experiences. Don't forget to post any bugs you encounter and remember, enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: This has taken a long time to Brew... [Game Update]
notes.content:
Hello,

I wanted to give you a detailed update of all the changes coming to Coffee Shop Tycoon and some insight into why I have been so busy working on the next update. 
In order to accomplish the new features I wanted for the game, I had to rehaul two major systems in the game: Customer AI, and Grid System (placing objects). I started by creating the Customer AI from scratch using a better architecture to handle more complex states, this will enable customers to have more advanced interactions in the future and was also required to allow a smarter navigation system for a feature that I will describe in a moment. After dealing with all the new AI, I started to modify the Grid System to allow more dynamic placements and reduce the number of wasted spaces in your shop. All those changes to introduce…. Store Expansions!!!

[h1]Store Expansions[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/5a13675407ad5d1b700a706f794f1151163da732.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/98df5326edf40f1b1e610d636c7575c055961204.jpg[/img]

Starting on the next update you will be able to unlock new areas on your shops. You can expand your shop by reaching the required reputation level and paying an expansion fee. The Second and Third shop will have this option available, so you can start placing tables and decorations on the sidewalk or over a nice deck next to the lake. New stores will also feature expansions and will be created with this feature in mind to offer interesting options and multiple expansions.

[h1]New Items[/h1]

This effort would not be complete without having new cool things to buy and customize your shop, so the new update will add 20 new objects, including tables, firepits, plants, and even some big shared tables so people can chill on your store while working on their homework. notes.title: Update v0.4.6 is live and Custom Logos are here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, for the last updates I have been working on giving more customization options, from changing the walls’ colors to now managing your shop’s branding. The new update adds two new features, custom logo/uniform color and custom logos.

[h1]Custom Logos[/h1]
Now you can pick your favorite icons and images and use them as your shop’s logo, just got to the branding options by clicking on your shop’s logo and start adding new logos, square images will work best as rectangles will be resized to fit the logo size. If you don’t like the logo anymore you can simply delete it by moving your mouse over the icon and clicking the trash can. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/f57bde76fd2816638fee7156e1f30acd23c51fa2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Custom Colors[/h1]
Logos used to be a single image that included the icon and the background, a similar story happened for the cup’s texture, so you were stuck with the colors I had picked. Now you can change that, every logo has a customizable background color, this includes custom logos if the image has transparency, feel free to try any combination that works best for your shop, this color will be used for your coffee cups and employee uniforms too, so they will dress according to your branding.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/4b2a68d3ac20ab19ebfbec896c77752b90376623.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
This update also includes some bug fixes for Mac, including a problem getting the “Creator” achievement, a bug storing custom drinks, and a bug where the HQ Marketing options were not working on Mac.

[h1]What’s Next[/h1]
This is the last customization update for now as I will start focusing on more meaty features, the following are the things I’m planning on adding to the game, starting with rival stores (AI) and more table options.
[list]
[*]Rival stores(AI)
[*]Improved grid system, more table options (shared tables, tables against walls)
[*]Categories for store items (Tables, Chairs, Decoration, etc.)
[*]New Location
[*]Improved customer feedback system
[*]Help Section
[*]Steam Workshop
[/list]

I hope you have enjoyed the updates so far and stay tuned as many more things are coming. Enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: Update v0.4.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello, I want to introduce the first big customization update and tell you a little more about what I will be working on next. This update although it doesn’t look as big as the CEO update includes some interesting changes to the way you perceive your shop and how you customize it. I will start with the coolest new feature, customizing wall/floor paint.

[h1]Changing the wall’s and floor’s paint.[/h1]
There is no greater way to have a unique shop than to be able to customize every inch of it, from the furniture and layout of your items to changing the wall paint and floor tiles. Included in this update is the ability to select a new wall paint and apply it to different segments in your wall, you can mix and match the different options between your walls to achieve the look you are looking for. “Why was this difficult to implement?” you may ask, well the thing here is that I wanted to provide more control over the painting of the walls so that you would be able to paint segments not the entire wall, this required coming up with systems to create these new walls dynamically by segment instead of using the static one piece wall I had on every shop.
Not only you can paint the walls but also the floor. The floor is a little different as the paint will apply to all the surface, this is to keep some of the cool wood textures used in the shops without making them look like a tileable repetitive pattern.
This brings us to the next feature, “What is the coolest way to enjoy the new customizable space?” – Add more camera options!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/76b833ad063db9817c81565fd7e3e1d18776a5a6.png[/img]

[h1]New Camera Options (Rotate, Wall View)[/h1]
All right I have a system that creates and configure walls on demand, why stay with the one side walls that all shops used to have? why not add walls on all sides? That is the question I asked myself so I decided to implement a new camera system and created walls for all sides of your shop, this means double the space to hang pretty drawings and decorations.
The new camera system allows you to rotate the camera and Hide/Show walls. It also has a new UI to allow doing this more easily.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/2dff09ae1fe3c9b4c03255b96adbc7a4d9e59ee9.png[/img]

[h1]Camera HotKeys[/h1]
Some of these Keys already existed but I will put them here in case you are not familiar with them, my intention is to add this information to a controls section in settings later on.
R-Rotate camera
C-Change camera mode (Fixed/Free). Fixed(Camera will not move, MouseScroll will not zoom in/out), Free(Camera will move and zome in/out)
T-Changes Wall visibility (Hidden/Partial/Full)
A,W,S,D-Moves camera

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Several bug fixes, including a crash fix that prevented Mac users from winning the “Quarks Achievement”.

[h1]Next Updates[/h1]
Next updates will be a little smaller compared to this one and will include the following:
[list]
[*]Import custom store logo
[*]Logo and background will be divided so you can customize the background color of the logo
[*]Custom uniform color
[*]Custom Cup Color
[*]Update to "Featured Drink" screen animations
[*]Featured Drinks tweaks
[*]Use specific avatar model according to their type (Casual/Teen/Expert). Right now, a model that was intended for example to be used only for Expert customers can be used for Teen and Casual customers. This change will make your location demographic look different according to your shop's drinks options. 
[*]Balancing. After all the changes that went in in the previous update a global balancing is required.
[/list]

Thanks everyone for reading this far and feel free to give me feedback abouth things that you want to see on the game next. Enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: CEO update is out + Halloween treat
notes.content:
Hello!

After long nights of work and way too many coffees the CEO update is here! The update is the biggest so far and many systems have been improved, some of you jumped into the beta branch and tried these new features ahead of time, thanks for helping me on the bumpy road, I will describe the new features below to give you a jump start.

[h1]New Rating System[/h1]
The new rating system now depends on your decoration rating, and your reputation, there are also three new top-rated ranks (Bronze Bean, Silver Bean, Golden Bean) that provide additional benefits like increased idle income from your shop.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/c015e021d4f03fa8b7cc9b80161c39df6ad61b0f.png[/img]

[h1]New customization options for furniture[/h1]
Several items have a new customization option to change their color when buying them, providing you with more options and a better looking shop.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/3fc807d73f6076fb8a91d55ca717af2a52087248.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/beb948b05472391ae9d7c4d993a3ebcefb58b9c6.png[/img]

[h1]New Items[/h1]
New items like high tables and bar stools are now available from the store. Also, a brand-new Working Station to brew your magical brown water.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/12c2fa2ca779859ccbcef4bfc92e7ba278f40789.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/4fe4dc0f08dd2f04b5ee8e29f411a7326dac9ece.png[/img]

[h1]New option for Supply Manager Specialization[/h1]
Supply manager can also order the new resource "Ingredients".

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/742d92374bc93a9a4285a9bd4573b5965c853637.png[/img]

[h1]New resource[/h1]
New resource "Ingredients" becomes available for higher levels, your demand will depend on the active drinks and their ingredients.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/c9653507f6822ec5137c0d1163f4a3883df5f0ba.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/158973e7f456ed5425774c91d5ba6fa8bf7dc0e9.png[/img]

[h1]Custom Drinks[/h1]
Have you ever dreamt of creating your own drinks? Well now is the time, with Custom drinks you are able to create and sell your own creations, just make sure people actually like them.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/4c0efd4e4cb9d2c49a405dd626c0f0d2f020a09a.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/c0675067f607a7c9c6173c56aa68128a806b1d88.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/d799b4b525a0e11e88415b477d0f4b02d78e275b.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/3cf801f31a7555fc10335dd04d80d2ec5bf596b4.png[/img]

[h1]Flavor profiles and Ratings[/h1]
With the addition of Custom drinks now customers have different flavor preferences which will make some drinks more popular than others, this also adds three different types of customers "Teens, Casuals, and Experts". Depending on their type they will prefer different types of drinks, keep an eye on the new rating indicators.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/02e7f4a5a6a6af3ea063d868238cc1cc345afd82.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/d5443858963ec183eef1f7afa61d74e3134aca15.png[/img]

[h1]Featured Drinks[/h1]
Do you want to boost the popularity of your awesome new creation? You can feature it on your menu! Just be aware of the current trends and market.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/75a828354fa309342c77a4fe4672d8d61b14d668.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/2a109f784912550114e7999a920d4cf2eb6972c3.png[/img]

[h1]Headquarters[/h1]
No better place to manage your coffee emporium than from a fancy office. You can now unlock the HQ and manage your stores, you will be able to create custom Drinks from there, transfer employees, manage advances marketing campaigns, or check your store's idle income and stats.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/26e9d0c62ee1a181bf26d6ffb8d6805efd5c1426.png[/img]

[h1]Franchise management[/h1]
Check your stores stats and idle income.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/23fd0b050e64441bfcc1ac99a112443e07d97be2.png[/img]

[h1]Loans[/h1]
Short on money? Ask the bank for help.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/4e10ea1334d5467c476fb3fce917def44fd8ef89.png[/img]

[h1]Market Balance Campaigns[/h1]
With the inclusion of customer types now you can start marketing campaigns in your HQ to change the market, this lets you decide which type of market you want to focus on. Remember to balance your menu according to the market.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/2d4b7c3ebf5b1d279cb00eefe6aadf67becd76f8.png[/img]

[h1]New employee options[/h1]
Got a Barista Rockstar that you would like to transfer to a new shop? You can now from your HQ.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/37cddf463450a113831d1bc47c4b5c2474d67a40.png[/img]

[h1]New Researches[/h1]
New researches available to unlock more ingredients and syrups.

[h1]Four new avatars to spice up your clients' population[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/e22a138fd10f2df302966dbe8c83d668255174bb.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/27d1382003a952de1dc59f1b69b230ff1b372c2b.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes and other minor improvements[/h1]
The update also includes fixes for several bugs and other improvements.

[h1]Halloween!!![/h1]
Finally, I have a surprise treat for you, Halloween decorations! Get creative and fill your shop with spiders and smoky cauldrons :)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/ee4f724f8f5686ece369d0f7542c11560eb42af0.png[/img]

notes.content:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/27d1382003a952de1dc59f1b69b230ff1b372c2b.png[/img]

The update also includes fixes for several bugs and other improvements.

notes.title: CEO beta version update (v0.4.0.1.beta) is out
notes.content:
New breaking update for the beta is out, as mentioned on the previous announcement, this new update changes the way save files are stored to get over some space limitations with the previous method I was using to store the game, this change was also needed to support steam cloud saves in the future. I also removed some debug information in the drinks menu, you might have seen some words saying “false”, “true”. 
This is all for now, I’ll keep working on the remaining list of tasks to release the full update.

Thanks for playing.

notes.title: CEO update work in progress
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I wanted to give you an update on the current progress for the "CEO update" and talk about new mechanics that will be coming to the game.

[h1]Drink Creation and types of customer[/h1]
With the next update, my objective is to add more content and increase the depth of the simulation/customization so I'm adding "Drink Creation".  Starting with your third shop you will be able to research ingredients and create new drinks, the ingredients have different properties that will determine the flavor and traits of the drink depending how you mix it. On the following screenshot, you can see an example of the flavor profile on a new created drink (Bitter/Sour/Sweet). All the other numbers in the screenshot are just for testing purposes and I will explain the magic behind them.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/03e5c163db1db8b70c2cf72fa863edec26e3f5da.png[/img]

So, every time you create a new drink it will be judged by three types of customers just to give you an idea of what to expect when releasing it to the public. The three types are Casuals (Enjoy balanced drinks and are not super picky about them), Teens (Prefer mostly sweet drinks), Experts (The more robust and intense coffee flavor the better). These types of customers will start showing up in your store, new shops might have different demographics between them (still deciding), but the interesting part is that you will have to balance your menu to better serve these customers. Speaking of which a new indicator (“Flavor”) will be added to the customer Needs after unlocking the third shop so you will need to keep an eye on it. [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/a9dc30199a9401138a1e1c99eb968a40adc5663e.png[/img]

notes.title: June Update
notes.content:
Hello, I wanted to give you an update on the next updates. I’ve been working on implementing the new mechanics for the “CEO update” not every mechanic is complete yet but I’m releasing a set of the new mechanics on the next update, this includes the following changes:

[h1]Employee Salary/Happiness[/h1]
I improved the employee system to provide a more realistic experience, in the next update employees will have a happiness meter, this will be affected by their compensation and training, giving you the option to adjust their salary. Based on their level, employees will request a higher salary, if their expectations are met they will be happy, if not they will gradually become angry until quitting if you don’t improve their salary. Employees are also able to gain a performance boost based on their salary. Training is now also a way to increase your employee’s happiness.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/ea2bdf4708d0ffeda26a2a66430f5b8865606479.png[/img]

[h1]Specializations[/h1]
I’ve heard several times comments about how the game gets repetitive after a while, that is why I’m introducing employee specializations. When you employee reaches certain level he will be able to develop a specialization, currently he can become a “Top Barista” or a “Supply Manager”.

[b]Top Barista[/b] -- This employee will be able to automatically brew coffee based on their orders.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/0db74480d8ecbf858b33299fa9991849f6bb7529.png[/img]

[b]Supply Manager[/b] -- This employee can restock beans and food and drop old beans/food based on their orders.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/bb0214c9e1d8a66f88cdad03e29a683575018db5.png[/img]

With these two new specializations, you can automate the process of running your shop, giving you more room to think about more impactful decisions for your business.

You can expect this update to roll out within one week.
The “CEO update” is still under development as it is a big update for the game and there are systems that need to be released at the same time in order to make sense. This update will feature a new shop, an office space, new items, missions, and mechanics like custom drink creation, loans, and advanced marketing.

This is all for now, keep playing and enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: Update v0.25 is live! Wi-Fi, New Beans, and other Services for your Shop.
notes.content:
Welcome to the new update of Coffee Shop Tycoon, as I mentioned on previous posts, there are new features and improvements to existing systems in this update.

The update has the following changes:

[h1]Improved item placing system[/h1]
[list]
[*]Allows you to move several items at the same time giving you the opportunity to clear up space without having to store the other items first.
[*]Includes option in Edit Mode to place objects from your inventory directly to your shop.
[*]Quick shortcut to buy again the last item.
[*]No more OK button.
[/list]

[h1]Improved Bean assignment system[/h1]
[list]
[*]Beans get automatically assigned to your machines and you can cycle between them from the brewer screen.
[*]No more assign to machine system nonsense.
[*]Empowers you to brew different beans without leaving one screen.
[/list]

[h1]New Research feature[/h1]
[list]
[*]Allows you to research new beans and food, and different services for your shop, from faster supply times to a rewards program.
[/list]

[h1]New Services feature[/h1]
[list]
[*]Customers now have different needs depending on your reputation level that require your shop to offer different services (Wi-FI, etc).
[/list]

[h1]New missions for the second coffee shop[/h1]

Another thing I had mentioned that was going to be included in this update was the Help Manual, I'm still working on this so expect it in the next updates.

As always if you have any issue with the new update let me know, I will be looking at crash reports and the forums to help you with any issue.

Enjoy your coffee. :)

notes.title: New Improvements and features coming to CST on February
notes.content:
Hello everybody, I've been working on new improvements and features that will be coming to CST Tycoon during the first part of February. I want to shed some light of what this new features will be and I hope to hear your feedback.

[h1]Research[/h1]
It is a new feature that allows you to define a monthly budget to spend on research, you will be able to unlock different upgrades like:
[list]
[*]Wifi service
[*]Faster supply
[*]Slower freshness decay
[*]New beans
[*]Improved food quality
[/list]
Research will also be the way to unlock new content in the store (ítems/counters/drinks) once they get added to the game.

[h1]Improvements to Object Placing[/h1]
"Why do I have to click OK after I placed my item?" This and other concerns are being addressed, the new Edit Mode is faster and easier to work with, when you place an item over the grid you won't need to click OK, if the item is in a position where it can't be placed you will see a message over the item telling you so. Another benefit of this new system is that if you decide to buy something that doesn't fit in the grid you can place it anywhere and move other items around until you have enough space, right now if you want to accomplish this you need to store the item, move the items in the grid to free space, go back to your stored items and place the item again.
Edit mode now also allows you to access your inventory from there so there is no need to go back to normal mode to place stored items.
You will also see a shortcut on your right to buy the last item again, this is very useful when buying chairs for example.

[h1]Improvements to Bean assignment[/h1]
Another system I'm improving is the Machine/bean assignment. Currently it is very annoying to brew different type of beans having to assign and remove beans from the brewer. The new system allows you to cycle between beans from the brewer screen allowing you to brew different beans.

[h1]Prioritizing Airpots[/h1]
Ever had that final cup of coffee in your airpot that won’t go away? Now you can prioritize an airpot and it will be used before the others.

[h1]Missions for the second coffee shop[/h1]
Right now only the first coffee shop has missions, new missions related to the new feature “Research” will be added to the second coffee shop, finishing this missions will unlock a new coffee shop once it is available.

[h1]Help Manual[/h1]
Last but not least every piece of advice you read from Mr. Danger will be available on a help section in case you find yourself lost or you simply want to better understand how a system works.

I don’t have any screenshots to show you right now but I will be adding them to this post later this week. See you soon and enjoy your coffee.

notes.title: Winter update (v0.2)
notes.content:
Brew yourself a cup of coffee and get ready to play Coffee Shop Tycoon, new features and content await you in this update, from a Christmas tree and a fireplace to the new seasonal menus that add a new level of management to your store.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/9574a62c8332c0b95180448140f79ab50c3d2f4a.png[/img]

[h1]New content[/h1]
Winter is here and with it the holiday spirit and bright lights. This update joins the festivities and brings to you new Christmas objects for your shop, so it can feel cozy during the cold weather.

The available drinks and food have also being increased to include drinks like Eggnog latte, Cranberry White Mocha or Salted Caramel Latte, and food like Red Velvet Cake and Gingerbread cookies.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/cd9647e61a04941b9bda20dc3dc134961be82be0.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/99749848c55726c770dd25aaabbc632db232fafa.png[/img]

Enjoy the season also with this new logos for your shop.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/082ab5aec701309ed02c5002e111f648a8b53e36.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/02483370f1340241eb514a9cc05d75987075f5e8.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/3d80fe3e5869b2699999854eccd174168f5d3ded.png[/img]

[h1]Seasonal menus[/h1]
Knowing which drinks to have in your menu is very important now, drinks have different traits like temperature and seasonality. Seasonal drinks will give you a reputation boost when they are used during their season but will impact negatively if they are out of season, not everyone wants a menu full of cold drinks in winter.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/d81c9dcc6946872991eb007d247b4f52a119d1e3.png[/img]

With this new addition you are now able to create different menus depending on the season, this menus can be set to change automatically so you only have to worry about creating the best menu for each season and it will be used during the season.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/7fb592d475429ddb658147d0f05a1eb2bf79f266.png[/img]

The required machines information has also being improved so you can quickly understand what is missing to serve that amazing drink.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/f5d8085d33c1a1406684d0d3196df6aa50d6318d.png[/img]

[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
Freshness decay is something I read a lot, that is why the freshness decay rate has been decreased by half, but be mindful that customers now will react more to the freshness of your drinks and coffee, be prepared to see some angry faces if you are serving old drinks.
There were other bugs fixed during this update and a crash that could happen while firing an unassigned employee.

This is the last update of this year as I will be out for the next two weeks visiting family, but I’ll keep working on new feature for you during January. Thank you for supporting the game and see you next year.

notes.title: October Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I know I’ve been a little quite but I have been working on the game, I’ve been mostly fixing bugs and working on details here and there to improve the quality of the game, however there are some new features that I will share with you.

[h1]Bonuses[/h1]
Understanding your customers and making them happy is your top priority, that’s why I worked to improve the Customers information screen to show you how their happiness is being affected by your coffee shop, this includes now something called “Bonuses”, depending on certain factors like the variety in your menu, the diversity of beans used to brew coffee, and later additional services like “rewards” or “Wi-Fi” will affect the overall happiness. When your coffee shop becomes popular good coffee will not be enough for your customers, so you will have to meet their expectations. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/8f550e0c70dcd4e1ac00ea92d95b56fd7b39126e.png[/img]

[h1]More detailed information[/h1]
Tycoon games are about understanding your business and improving it, there were several changes to show you more detail about your coffee shop, from brewed coffee types to detailed expenses, and employee level progress, this changes are not too flashy but they really help with the game flow to aid you in making better decisions.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/6d420c75a8aa1603b8f5fbade519c9e2565cd786.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/fa1adae7db9d547bf212adc9ba25c8d70b81c40d.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/4a439eb46976773f0c238e193de222e8c646edec.png[/img]

[h1]Notifications[/h1]
I worked also on a major overhaul for the notification system, previously unlocking drinks or food used very simple text notifications which were not very interesting. This is however a big drive to improve your store, every new drink and food should feel like an achievement. The new notifications convey this importance and are more gratifying.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/1b229066336c525d4171c34670503706fff9fd07.png[/img]

[h1]Effects[/h1]
To improve also major events notifications new effects were added to the already existing notifications.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/f67d223df1bfedc322a13db673bd76eb0cdd2e03.png[/img]

[h1]Coffee Shop Awards[/h1]
This is something I imagined since the original concept of the game, because how can you tell that your coffee shop is the best without some fancy prices and trophies? Well the Coffee Shop Awards add just that, when your shop is famous enough you will start to receive invitations to the awards, if you manage to win you will receive prices and a popularity boost so keep brewing and don’t forget to bring your moustache to the awards.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/7ee9157379374068a0b96e5757d88c11cbf4e7d4.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/582c04f3ad85f549c71627cfca7b475b4d4f964d.png[/img]

[h1]Marketing Assets[/h1]
Marketing is the main way to bring more customers if you think you can handle them, but having a list with campaign names is not very fun so I made some drawings that will show you why advertising coffee with ninjas is more interesting than magazines, I hope you enjoy the illustrations. ːsteamhappyː

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/a6c8db4a43d6ab896869e31112905c75ae9d2104.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/e5254323753e8b2c56d839acff54c65cbd78aa9e.png[/img]

[h1]Profile Manager[/h1]
This was obviously a must before the game was released, you can play the game now with different profiles and if there is no way to save your shop from bankrupt you can always start a new game, but before doing that remember that you can try selling your furniture and fancy espresso machines to survive.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25924491/3dda60bdc406fa256ff731e5400676b28d8dd190.png[/img]

That is all for now and hopefully we’ll have a cup of coffee together in the following months.
